purpose: Determine which components of an approved property answer may be safely reused for a related citizen question and which components require fresh property evidence, date verification or legal revalidation.
core_principle: RELATED ANSWER → COMPARE SCOPE → CLASSIFY REUSE → FRESH CHECKS → REUSE SAFELY
rules: Semantic similarity does not establish legal or property equivalence.
A property-specific conclusion is never copied to another property merely because the facts look similar.
Current evidence is not reused as historical evidence without temporal verification.
Historical evidence is not reused as current evidence without currentness verification.
Legal propositions may be reusable only after authority, version, commencement and scope checks.
Procedures and deadlines require current verification when the new question depends on them.
A reused citation is not itself property-specific evidence.
Limitations attached to reused material remain visible.
Reuse never bypasses the current investigation quality gate.
The original published snapshot remains immutable.
hard_stops: Never copy ownership or title conclusions between properties.
Never treat similar wording as identical legal questions.
Never reuse stale procedure or deadline information without verification.
Never silently broaden or change the target date.
Never use related content to bypass property matching.
Never hide limitations from the source answer.
